summary: Welcome sweeps an open hand in toward your body, as if inviting someone in. It's used for greeting arrivals and in the phrase 'you're welcome.'
steps: Hold an open hand out in front of you, palm up, a little to the side.
Sweep it inward toward your body, ending near your waist.
Pair it with a welcoming face and a slight nod.
mistakes: Sweeping outward instead of inward. The motion brings the person toward you.

faq.q: Is this the same as 'you're welcome'?
faq.a: Many signers use WELCOME for 'you're welcome' too. There's a dedicated clip for YOU'RE-WELCOME; both are understood.
